none: PAS CAM-E53E54: Copper-alloy Radiate Roman Coin of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy radiate of Tetricus I, 271-274. Obverse shows radiate bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Mint is Gaul, Mint 2, Reece period 13. Obverse shows radiate bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows Laetitia standing left, holding purse and anchor. Reverse legend reads [LAETITIA AVGG/N]. Conditon is fine, die axis is 1.86g, weight is 1.86g, diameter is 17.07mm. See…
